test_objective: Check that you can query some attributes from an entity

test_cases.name: 018_01_02 Query some attributes from an entity
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query some attributes from an entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: attrs set to '${attributes_to_be_retrieved}'
}
